ctccore.station.status.1: Insert a weapon, armor or tool
ctccore.station.status.3: This chip is at its stack limit
ctccore.station.build.short: 3x3 casing floor, 4 corner pillars, 3x3 casing roof with glass in the middle.
ctccore.station.build.3: Middle: this block, casing pillars at the 4 corners
ctccore.station.build.4: Roof: 3x3 Research Casing, glass in the centre
ctccore.station.build.5: Cables, hoppers and pipes connect to any frame block
ctccore.station.build.6: Redstone signal on the core = automatic
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_1: Start with a 3x3 floor of Research Casing
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_2: The Research Station goes in the middle, on top of the floor
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_3: Put a casing pillar on each of the four corners. The middle of each side stays open
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_4: Finish with a 3x3 casing roof. The block in the middle must be glass
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_5: When the frame is complete, it lights up and the station is ready
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_6: Every block of the frame is a port: cables, hoppers and pipes can connect anywhere on it
ctccore.ponder.research_station.text_7: Take one block away and the whole station switches off
ctccore.ponder.research_station_use.head: Implanting chips
ctccore.ponder.research_station_use.text: Open the station and put in a weapon, armor or a tool, a chip and a Uranium Rod
Every implant also needs 60,000 FE. The panel in the middle shows what the chip will do
Iron and weaker gear holds 1 chip, diamond and better 2, a Chip Socket adds one more. A new chip replaces the oldest and gives part of its material back
A redstone signal next to the core makes it automatic: it starts as soon as everything is inside

ctccore.chip.iron.armor: 20% less damage from arrows per chip
ctccore.chip.kinetic.weapon: Knocks the target back (more per chip); Voidstep Rapier: +4 blink range
ctccore.chip.kinetic.armor: Jump again in mid-air to dash forward (4 s), soft landing

ctccore.chip.vein.tool: Pickaxe only: mines the whole ore vein (sneak = one block)
ctccore.chip.harvest.tool: Hoe only: harvests the whole field, drops more and replants

ctccore.ponder.voidsteel_processing.head: Processing Voidsteel
ctccore.ponder.voidsteel_processing.text: Raw Voidsteel goes through Crushing Wheels: one piece becomes two Crushed Voidsteel
A furnace only gets one ingot out of a raw piece, the Create way gets two
Mix 2 Crushed Voidsteel with a Chorus Fruit in a Basin over a lit Blaze Burner
Over a superheated burner (Blaze Cake) an ingot melts into 90 mB of Molten Voidsteel
Spouts need it for chips, Voidsteel weapons and armor, Void Tipped Arrows and the Voidforge Template
A Mechanical Press over the basin turns 90 mB back into an ingot
ctccore.ponder.chip_assembly.text_1: Chips are made by Sequenced Assembly: a belt or depots under a Deployer, a Spout and a Mechanical Press
ctccore.ponder.chip_assembly.text_2: Blank Chip: a Copper Sheet gets a Gold Nugget and Polished Rose Quartz from Deployers, then a press. Three rounds
ctccore.ponder.chip_assembly.text_3: About 1 in 10 fails into Chip Scrap. Crush it to get copper and gold back
ctccore.ponder.chip_assembly.text_4: Every chip: Blank Chip, then its material from a Deployer, 250 mB of its fluid from a Spout, and a press
ctccore.ponder.chip_assembly.text_5: Most chips use water or lava. Liquid Oxygen, Molten Mercury, Sulfuric Acid and Crude Oil come from a Mixer. JEI shows each recipe
ctccore.ponder.chip_assembly.text_6: The Chip Socket is assembled the same way: Brass Sheet, Precision Mechanism, Blank Chip, press
ctccore.ponder.voidsteel_finishing.text_: Voidsteel weapons and the Cracked Voidsteel armor start in Mechanical Crafters, in the usual shape
What comes out is still unfinished: the void channels are empty
A Spout pours 250 mB of Molten Voidsteel into it, and the piece is done
Arrows under the same Spout take 25 mB each and become Void Tipped Arrows. Diamond Tipped ones come from a Mixer
The Voidforge Template and the Void Sigil are Sequenced Assembly too: Deployer, Spout and Press, two rounds
